concept.title: Installing X-Author Contracts Without an Installer

prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Contracts for Cloud on Salesforce Summer 2019 User Guide

conbody.p: This is an alternate method of installing X-Author Contracts for Cloud. If you have an X-Author Contracts for Cloud installer, you do not need to perform the steps described under this topic. You need to perform these steps only if you do not have an installer file and you need to create an XML manifest file.
